# `app.graycard.catalog.lightSourceType`

A UV / contact-printing exposure light source (for alternative processes and contact printing). instance.lightSource references this. (Enlarger illumination lives on enlargerType.headType instead.)

- **Source:** `lexicons/app/graycard/catalog/lightSourceType.json`
